messages:
kari_sales: Heads up - SolsticeBank wants a BYO-key POC. Key asks: 3-way split custody (us-east, eu-central, ap-sg), hot rotation every 12h, and proof of HSM attestation on every rotate. They also asked whether imported RSA-2048 keys are supported and if there’s a per-key import fee.

devon_sre: quick clarifying q: are they doing sign-only (RSA PRI sign) or decrypt too? also do they want keys stored on our partner HSM or bring their own HSM appliance?

kari_sales: they said sign + occasional decrypt for legacy payloads. customer will provide master key material for import (BYOK). POC window 72h, want a canary rotate after 24h, full rotate at 48h and forced failover to ap-sg at 60h.

omar_security: we support RSA-2048 import via our secure import flow (split wrapping with KMS and HSM unwrap) — need them to do an encrypted key blob using our import tool. We can attest FIPS 140-2 L3 on partner HSMs and provide signed attestation bundles per rotate. For split custody we can run threshold wrap with 2-of-3 Redwood shares + customer share.

maria_custrep: pricing question: they asked for "per-key import one-time" and "per-1M RSA sign ops" plus any inter-region failover surcharge. Can we give presales numbers?

devon_sre: presales estimate (non-binding):
- One-time key import: $1,200 per key (includes secure ceremony, import logs, audit packaging)
- RSA sign ops: $65 per 1M ops (RSA sign tends to be heavier than ECDSA)
- Cross-region failover surcharge: $20 per 1M ops (covers HA routing + egress)
Also, note concurrency limits: each HSM slot handles ~800 concurrent RSA-sign pipelines; bursts above that may queue and raise p95 latency.

kari_sales: they also want sample API calls and audit evidence format to show to compliance team. can we paste a curl example and what logs look like?

omar_security: sample sign API (POC key import flow):
```bash
# sign with imported key
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/kms/sign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key_id":"import-cust-01","algo":"RSA_PKCS1_2048","payload":"<base64>"}'
```
Audit excerpt (simplified):
```
{ timestamp: "2025-06-14T12:03:22Z", event: "KEY_UNWRAP", key_id: "import-cust-01", actor: "redwood-hsm-01", attestation_sig: "MEUCIQ..." }
```
We provide full signed attestation chain plus an HSM event log bundle per rotation.

maria_custrep: they also raised concern about key escrow: they want no plaintext escrow in Redwood control plane. Are we ok only storing wrapped blobs that are decryptable only by customer's KEK?

omar_security: yes - default is we only store wrapped blobs. If they want Redwood to hold an escrow copy we require a legal EULA addendum; for the POC we'll do wrapped-only escrow under their KEK with retention 14 days unless they request otherwise.

devon_sre: SRE notes for POC runbook to share:
1) Validate import: import small RSA key and run sign validation (10k signs).
2) Canary rotate at 24h: rotate a single key id, verify attestation bundle + 10k sign pass.
3) Full rotate at 48h with simulated eu-central egress outage for 10m to test failover to ap-sg.
4) Run high-throughput burst test: 2k QPS 5m windows every hour. Collect p50/p95/p99.
Include smoke dashboards + alert if unwrap error rate >0.1%

kari_sales: can someone produce a short customer-ready summary of limits and contract asks? I'll include pricing and SQ notes in the SOW.

maria_custrep: I'll ask them for org contacts, legal point for escrow, and whether third-party custodian is mandatory. Also will confirm if 12h rotation is a hard requirement or negotiable to 24h.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-2044 - "SolsticeBank BYOK 3-way split custody import + rotate" - assignees: @kari_sales @devon_sre @omar_security

kari_sales: next steps: 1) maria to collect contacts & confirm escrow policy, 2) devon to draft SRE checklist + concurrency caveats, 3) omar to draft SQ answers and sample attestation bundle. I'll package and send to customer tomorrow morning. :rocket:
